Bring the whole family to this place with lots of space for fun. There is plenty of space on the terrace. There is a trampoline and a short distance to the forest and playground.

It takes about 16 minutes to Oslo Airport Gardermoen and about 30 minutes to Oslo.

Guest access
There are two rooms in the house that are locked, otherwise all rooms are available.

Other things to note
Bed linens and towels are included.
